              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable identifier shared by owners at the same household (same last name and address).
              type: string
              example: 'H-3f9a2b7c1e5d'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: Consolidated duplicate-detection key, 'normalizedTelephone|email' (email empty when absent). Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identity keys match, so members of one household with different telephones are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|jo@example.test'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points - 2 when an email is on file, 1 when the owner had no namesakes at creation, 2 for a household of three or more, and 3 when tenure exceeds 365 days.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level derived from membershipPoints - 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5 and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived from the city (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.

              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's segment formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>' - TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more else 'STANDARD', AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW/VIC/QLD) else 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created today, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners, approaching the capacity limit of 50, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: True when the owner has been soft-deleted (DELETE flags the record rather than removing it); false for a live owner.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when another owner shared this owner's last name and postcode (with a different telephone) at creation time, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matched at creation time, present only when possibleDuplicate is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

              description: The owner's IANA timezone derived from the locality/region (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, 'EMAIL' when an email is on file, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band derived from birthDate against registrationDate - 'MINOR' (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+). Absent when no birthDate is on file.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so July-December fall in the following year's fiscal year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by its id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: Optional honorific (MR/MRS/MS/DR). When present it is prefixed to the salutation.
          type: string

The unified `memberId` is `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`, assembled in one place and threaded through the existing pipeline with minimal disturbance:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — replaced the three DTO fields (`customerCode`, `membershipNumber`, `checkDigit`) with a single read-only `memberId`. This is what the test observes (`memberId` present, old two absent).

## Design notes on keeping structural impact low

- **The `Owner` entity is untouched.** Its `customer_code` column now simply stores the unified memberId — a legacy column name behind a renamed concept, which avoids editing a large, high-WMC class and the DB schema. Renaming that field/column would have added the biggest cost multiplier for zero behavioural gain, since the id is invisible at the persistence layer.
- **`DeduplicateCustomerCode` is untouched.** It already dedupes on the stored id, so collision handling now applies to the memberId for free — the spec's requirement is met without a change.
- **Fiscal year and owner segment** stay consistent with the memberId: the FY inside the id and the `fiscalYear` field both come from `FiscalYear.of(registrationDate)`, and the owner segment keys off `locality`, which is the same region prefix embedded in the id.
